I, for one, welcome our new UNIX primitive AI overlords
John Mark Walker
·
25 September 2026
·
3 min read
Jev was released to much fanfare on September 20, 2026, by Typesafe.ai. It’s one of those moments where there’s a “before” and an “after”. For years, now, we’ve been told that we must have more compute, more storage, more memory, and more datacenters . More, more, more… the AI juggernaut has an insatiable hunger for all things infrastructure. This was the lie promulgated by Sam, Amodei, and to some extent, even Jensen.
